data.notes: Confirmed September 2026 underground/diaspora programming is concentrated around Mogli The Key and Naô Pool Club, with most listings released as recurring daytime pool-club residencies rather than one-off warehouse or late-night club bills.

events.title: Afrobrunch x Mogli
events.summary: Afrobrunch lands at Mogli as a weekly Thursday daytime Afro-culture pool party, billed around Afrobeat, DJs and a global crowd, with the promoter positioning it among Spain’s leading Afro music experiences.

events.title: KISSTORY Marbella: The Closing Party
events.summary: KISSTORY’s Marbella closing pool party at Naô, billed by the promoter as Marbella’s biggest pool party event, running 12:00–20:00 with ticket tiers on sale.

events.title: Afrobeast x Mogli
events.summary: Tuesday daytime residency at Mogli built around Afrobeats, Amapiano, Hip-Hop and Afro-House, with top DJs and surprise performances across the summer season.

events.title: Thomas Helmig at Marbella Arena
events.summary: Thomas Helmig’s official site lists a Marbella Arena concert on Friday 4 September 2026, with a post-concert DJ party. The page notes the Marbella Arena shows on 4 and 5 September are sold out.

events.title: Thomas Helmig at Marbella Arena
events.summary: Thomas Helmig’s official site lists a second Marbella Arena concert on Saturday 5 September 2026. The official event page also states that the Marbella Arena dates are sold out.

events.title: Homies x Vanity
events.summary: Friday Naô Pool Club residency advertised as Marbella’s #1 party, pairing Afro House, Hip-Hop, R&B and Amapiano with a champagne-and-shisha daytime pool-club format.

events.title: Not Like Us x Mogli
events.summary: Sunday Mogli pool-club residency framed as a luxury urban lifestyle party, with a curated soundtrack of Hip-Hop, RnB, Trap, Afrobeat and Amapiano.

events.title: R&B Lovers x Mogli
events.summary: Weekly Wednesday throwback poolside party focused on 90s and 00s R&B anthems, slow jams and classic club hits in Mogli’s daytime setting.

events.title: Apulanta at Marenostrum Fuengirola
events.summary: Marenostrum Fuengirola’s official page confirms Finnish band Apulanta for Saturday 12 September 2026 at the Escenario Fundación Unicaja/Castillo Sohail, a major Costa del Sol venue near Marbella. The special guest is still listed as to be announced.

events.title: Guilty · Champagne Spray Party
events.summary: Naô’s daytime hip-hop Champagne Spray Party, confirmed for September dates and built around a Monday pool-club social format with high-energy bottle-service moments.

events.title: Caôs on Thursday
events.summary: Thursday daytime hip-hop pool party at Naô, pairing VIP-table pool-club energy with a dedicated Hip-Hop Music format across September dates.

events.title: Uden Sunday
events.summary: Sunday Naô session confirmed for two September dates, advertised as an open-format party spanning Afro Vibes, House and R&B.

events.title: B2B · Back to Back
events.summary: Naô’s Tuesday daytime electronic and house residency, promoted as a back-to-back pool-club format for electronic music lovers with September dates listed.
